headline: Last session: Indian benchmark indices face extended weekly losing streak amid sharp global selling and FII outflows

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Foreign institutional investors selling Indian equities en-masse
Surging crude oil prices fueling inflation and trade concerns
Global interest rate hikes sparking persistent capital outflows
Widespread market volatility and weak international market cues
whatHappening: Indian benchmark shares posted their longest weekly losing run in 25 years
Equity markets recorded eight consecutive weeks of fall and their worst month since March
Sensex crashed over 1,000 points in recent sessions, wiping out massive investor wealth
NSE and BSE are closed today, Saturday, 3 October 2026, for the weekend
summary: Indian equity markets have suffered a prolonged downturn, posting their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years. Heavy selling by foreign investors alongside rising oil prices and global interest rate fears drove recent market losses. The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 5 October.
